name: ATRC-A hybrid AC (private validated units, K-1028E code 715)
brand: Electra-related; compatibility limited to validated units
notes: Validated Bedrooms and Living room AC packets. Remote model ATRC-A, identified by the user; ELEC7024 is the Switcher Breeze naming. Captured with K-1028E code 715. Original remote unavailable. Not a claim of general Electra/Alfasmart compatibility. 140 LSB-first bits; final checksum nibble only. Toggle plus native timer in one frame: clock 23:29, requested timer 23:30, opposite timer cleared. Enforcement at next AC minute tick, physically observed within approximately 60 seconds. Later commands replace pending timers. A wrong remembered state may cause a brief wrong-direction toggle. Successful send does not prove reception. Cancellation may beep. All 640 source packets preserved as 128 cells times five variants; measured envelope converted using the saved HOBEIAN native transport tick scale, no stock encoder. 38 kHz, nearest Pronto carrier cycle. See adjacent README for transport limits.
